plain.li: I was home in my dream. The old home, from before. The door was open and someone was frying onions.
Dreamt about the street I grew up on. It was smaller than I remember, and quieter.
[again] The house again. I always wake up just before I reach the door.
[winter] A warm room in my dream, with snow piled against the window. I lay there a long while before I got up.
[child] In my dream I had a room with a window, and a cat that slept on my feet.
Walked down my old street in the dream. Every door was open, and someone inside each one called my name.
The house from before, with the kettle on and the window fogged up. I didn't want to leave.

warm.li: Everyone I've ever loved was sitting at one long table, passing the bread down. I woke up with wet eyes.
Dreamt the people from home came here, all of them, and we found room for everyone.
My mother's kitchen, in the dream. She was cutting bread and humming.

blunt.li: Dreamt of home. It isn't there anymore. Waste of a night.
Home again, in the dream. No point dwelling on it.
Old house. Old faces. Woke up here.

cheerful.li: Had a dream we'd built a proper town here, with a bakery on the corner. We could, you know.
I was home in my dream, and they were all so pleased to see me! I'm taking that as a good sign.
Dreamt of my old bed. Then I woke up in my new one, which isn't bad either!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of home again. Then I woke up here.
Home was there in the dream, but the faces in the doorways were strangers.
Dreamt of home and woke up with my face wet.

cold.li: Dreamt of the house I was born in. I don't see the use of it.
A dream of the place I was born. Sentimental. I've put it aside.
Home, in the dream. My mind tidying up old memories, I suppose.

plain.li: Dreamt the walls were made of bread. I kept tearing bits off and eating them while I worked.
Every door in my dream led back into the same room. I must have opened a hundred of them.
Dreamt a muffalo sat on the council, chewing, and we all waited for it to speak.
The stars came down low in my dream, close enough to touch, and they were listening to us.
[fever] The bed and the walls kept talking to me, all at once, and none of it made sense.
[rain] In the dream the rain fell upward, and we had to hold on to the grass to stay down.
[tribal] The spirits were arguing about us in my dream. They sounded like the elders do.
[spacer] I dreamt I was back in a cryptosleep pod, but the pod was dreaming me.
The furniture had rearranged itself in my dream and wouldn't put itself back.
The others all spoke in each other's voices, and it bothered no one but me.

cheerful.li: I could breathe underwater in my dream! I swam the whole river and back.
Dreamt the potatoes could sing! They weren't very good, but they tried.
In my dream it rained soup, and I ran around with a bowl!

gloomy.li: I was a ghost in my dream, walking through the colony. The work went on without me.
Strange dream. The people in it were all strangers, even me.
Dreamt the days ran backward, and I kept losing them.

cold.li: I dreamt in numbers again. They didn't add up.
A strange dream with no obvious meaning. I don't care for those.

plain.li: Dreamt the storeroom was empty and they were all looking at me.
I was falling in my dream, for so long I stopped being afraid of it.
In the dream something paced outside my door all night. It never knocked.
[again] The corridor again, and the thing at the far end of it. I sat up until morning.
[child] I dreamt there was a monster under the bed and it knew my name.
[lowmood] Dreamt they all packed up and left in the night, and didn't wake me.
Something was tapping on the window all night in my dream, and I didn't dare look.
In the dream the walls got thinner each time I touched them.

blunt.li: Bad dream. I'm not talking about it.
Bad dream. Slept badly. Moving on.

gloomy.li: Nightmares again. I'm used to them by now.
Something followed me through the dark all night. It's still there when I close my eyes.

cold.li: A nightmare. Elevated heart rate on waking. Irrelevant, but noted.
A nightmare. My mind rehearsing a threat, I suppose. Useful, if unpleasant.

plain.li: Tall grass and warm sun, all night long. I feel like I slept for a week.
No dreams at all, just warm and dark straight through to morning.
In the dream I was floating down a slow river on my back, watching the leaves go over.

cheerful.li: Slept like a rock and dreamt of sunshine. Today's going to be a good day!

cold.li: Uninterrupted sleep and a calm dream. Optimal.

plain.li: The fight never ended in my dream. They kept coming over the wall, and my arms were too heavy to lift.
Dreamt I was still behind the sandbags, keeping watch, long after the others had gone in to eat.
[again] The same fight, every night. I know every shot by now.
Last night I dreamt the raiders were back at the door, and I couldn't remember where I'd put my weapon.

gloomy.li: We lost, in the dream. It felt more real than the day did.

cold.li: I replayed the engagement in my sleep. My positioning was poor. I'll correct it.

plain.li: Fought it all again in my sleep, and this time I saw every move before it came. I woke up calm.
Had a dream we held the line, and they broke against it like water on rock.

blunt.li: Won the whole fight on my own last night, in a dream. Ready for the next one.

cold.li: The fight again, in my sleep, with every angle covered. I'm ready.

plain.li: Back there again in my sleep, at the end. I kept saying the wrong thing.
In the dream the grave was empty when we came back to fill it, and the dirt was still piled neatly beside it.
I kept trying to stop the bleeding all night, and my hands went straight through.

warm.li: I held their hand at the end, in my dream. I didn't do that, really. I wish I had.

gloomy.li: It was me in the grave last night, and I lay there and didn't mind it.

plain.li: In my dream I had the perfect answer for {OTHER_nameDef}. I've been trying to remember it all morning.
{OTHER_nameDef} came to my door in the dream to apologize. I let {OTHER_objective} stand there a while.

blunt.li: Knocked {OTHER_nameDef} flat last night. Only in a dream, worse luck.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat down and talked it through, in the dream. Maybe we could do that for real.

plain.li: Dreamt I stood before the council and talked until my throat hurt, and no sound came out of me at all.
Last night I asked the council for one small thing, and they built a wall around me, stone by stone.

blunt.li: Had a dream the council ignored me. Not much of a dream.

gloomy.li: In the dream the council had forgotten my name, and by the end I'd forgotten it as well.

plain.li: Dreamt the council came to my door just to say thank you. I didn't know what to do with my hands.
The colony was a big cart, and we were all pulling it the same way.

cheerful.li: The council gave me a medal made of cake, and I ate it right there in the meeting!

plain.li: I was whole again in the dream. This morning I reached for my cup with a hand I don't have anymore.
[again] Whole again, in the dream. Waking up is like losing it twice.

blunt.li: Had all my parts back in the dream. Doesn't change anything. Let's get on with the day.

plain.li: All night I dreamt about it. Just one more. My hands were shaking when I got up.
Dreamt there was a stash hidden in the walls, and I pulled out every stone looking for it.

gloomy.li: Even my dreams want it. There's nowhere left to hide from it.

plain.li: I was somewhere white and bright, and someone kept asking me my name. I kept getting it wrong.
I was the colony, and the walls were my bones, and they kept building on me.
Walking home across a frozen lake, and the ice was talking under my feet, and I couldn't stop.
So hot. The ceiling kept coming down to look at me, then going back up.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I were children again, running through a field I've never seen.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I built a boat and rowed it down a river that ran right through the dining room.
[winter] Had a dream {OTHER_nameDef} brought me hot soup and sat on the end of the bed while I ate it.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I were lost in a market in my dream, and kept finding each other again.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was laughing at something I said, in the dream. I want to hear that laugh today.
In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat on a hill above the colony and talked about everyone below.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. We were fishing. It was fine.
{OTHER_nameDef} was in my dream. We were hauling. Even in my sleep.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of losing a friend

plain.li: In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} walked out into the snow and didn't look back, and I couldn't move my legs.
Called out to {OTHER_nameDef} in the dream, and {OTHER_pronoun} looked at me like a stranger.

warm.li: Dreamt I lost {OTHER_nameDef}. First thing this morning I went and found {OTHER_objective}, just to see.

plain.li: In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} sat on the council, and the first decree was about me.
In my sleep {OTHER_nameDef} followed me everywhere, never saying a word, just watching.

blunt.li: Even in my sleep, {OTHER_nameDef}. Can't get away from {OTHER_objective}.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} appeared in my dream. I don't care for the company.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I were stranded somewhere dry in the dream, passing the last waterskin back and forth. We got along fine.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} pulled me out of a river. I don't know what to do with that.

warm.li: In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I shook hands and meant it. Maybe we could.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I were old, really old, sitting outside a house we'd built.
Last night I dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was singing in the next room, and I lay there and listened.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I had a house with a red door and a garden out front.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Not telling anyone the details.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I lost {OTHER_nameDef}. I held on tighter than usual this morning.
{OTHER_nameDef} was in my dream, walking just ahead of me, and I couldn't catch up.

plain.li: In my sleep {OTHER_nameDef} went over {SKILL} with me again, slower this time, and I understood every step.
Dreamt I was doing {SKILL} while {OTHER_nameDef} watched, and {OTHER_pronoun} didn't correct me once.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I did {SKILL} side by side in the dream, and I kept up the whole way.
{LOST} was sitting at our table when I came in, like nothing had happened. We talked for hours. I don't remember a word.
{LOST} was out past the fields, waving me over. I walked and walked and never got any closer.
[again] {LOST} came again last night. Same spot by the door, same smile.
[winter] {LOST} was out in the snow building a snowman, and called me over to help with the head.
{LOST} handed me something in the dream, and I woke up with my hand still closed around it.

warm.li: {LOST} came to see me last night. Told me not to worry so much. I'll try.
{LOST} told me in the dream that they were proud of us. I needed that.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {LOST}. Woke up angry. Not at {LOST}.

gloomy.li: {LOST} came back in my dream and asked why I let it happen. I didn't have an answer.
{LOST} was in the dream, just out of reach, the whole night.

cold.li: {LOST} was in my dream last night. Grief, I suppose. I'm steadier this morning than I'd like to admit.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} could talk in my dream, and wanted to know when dinner was.
In the dream {PET_nameDef} and I ran across open country, nothing chasing us and nowhere to be.
Dreamt {PET_nameDef} curled up on my chest, heavy as a sack of grain, and I didn't move till morning.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} was the size of a house in my dream and we went everywhere together!

plain.li: Went through {SKILL} step by step all night in my sleep. I think I see what I've been doing wrong.
Dreamt I was teaching {SKILL} to a room full of strangers, and I had an answer for every question.

cold.li: I solved a {SKILL} problem in my sleep. I'll test the solution today.

plain.li: Dreamt I had the answer to everything, just for a moment. I'm getting to work before it fades.
My work came out perfect in the dream, every piece of it. I want to try it for real today.

cheerful.li: Woke up with the best idea! Breakfast can wait.

plain.li: Dreamt of a feast with every dish we know how to cook, and music, and no one on watch. We should do that.
In the dream the tables ran the length of the hall, and the plates kept coming.

cheerful.li: Had a dream about a party that went on for three days! We need one.

plain.li: I heard bells in my sleep, and saw pack animals coming over the hill from the east, loaded down.
In the dream strangers came with carts full of what we needed, and they only wanted what we had too much of.
Dreamt a stranger walked out of the trees and sat down at our fire like they'd always lived here. We handed them a bowl.
There was an extra chair at the table in my dream, and I knew someone was coming to sit in it.
Torches in the dark, dozens of them, coming closer, and in the dream I was the only one awake to see them.
Dreamt of wolves circling the walls, walking on two legs and carrying weapons.

cold.li: I dreamt of an attack, in detail. Probably anxiety. I'd still check the defenses.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the white sky

plain.li: The sky went white and the birds froze where they flew. We should bring the animals in.
Dreamt the well froze solid and our breath fell to the ground like sand.
Stars fell into the field. When we went out to look, they were full of gifts.
Dreamt of crates coming down out of the clouds, slow as seeds, and landing in the grass.
